newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down on US dlr trend overseas.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down on US dlr trend overseas.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday, reflecting the strength of the U.S. dollar overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.495 against Tuesday's T$27.475 close. Turnover was an active US$203.5 million.

Dealers said the Taiwan dollar started to react to the strengthening U.S. dollar against the yen overseas in the morning session. "U.S. dollar demand from importers also emerged actively," said one dealer. Foreign equity funds did not flow in much as previously expected, he said. A T$27.48-27.52 range was seen for Thursday. -- James Peng (2-5080815)
